caseName: Northwestern Pacific Railroad v. Public Utilities Commission
caseNameFull: NORTHWESTERN PACIFIC RAILROAD CO. v. PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF CALIFORNIA
attorneys: Thormund A. Miller, Jeremiah C. Waterman and Randolph Karr for appellant., Mary Moran Pajalich and Hector Anninos for appellee., Boris H. Lakusta for the City of San Rafael et al.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion of the City of San Rafael, California, et al. for leave to be named parties appellee is denied. The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
